description: Changes the in-app SDK options of the running session (the Stalls tab controls): stallThresholdMs is the main-thread watchdog threshold (one of 100, 150, 250, 500, 1000 ms; default 150), strictMode turns StrictMode violation reporting on (it changes the app's StrictMode policy; default off), inflateTracking turns layout inflation timing on or off (default on), rxTracking turns the SDK's RxJava 2 hooks on or off (they name the Rx chain and its subscribe site for each stall; default on; SDK 0.9.0+). Omitted fields stay as they are. Returns the options now in effect.
name: set_sdk_options
title: Set SDK options
